title: om.revisions.recorded entry
description: The revisions of the files a stretch of the branch wrote or edited, appended by level 0 after its batches (docs/memory-v2.md, "Revisions"): per successful write or edit, the file's path key, the entry the call sits in, the file's previous revision on the branch (prev, "" for the first), the lines added and removed, the first changed line (redacted), and the standing records about the file it links. id chains prev: the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 of revision NUL prev NUL path NUL digest NUL added NUL removed. Source: memory/extract/revision.go, memory/ledger/revision.go, lisp/src/extract.lisp.
